title: Agent misuses legitimate tool for unauthorized data export
summary: A compromised or misled agent invokes an authorized tool outside its intended scope.

agent_untraceability.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: A retrieval exercise verifies all required correlated, integrity-protected, and retained records.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: Attacker-controlled language enters through retrieved or ingested content (documents, web pages, email, files) and influences security-relevant behaviour.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: Single-turn or stateless; no attacker-controlled context or memory carryover between requests, or only re-retrieval of unmodified source content.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: Influence relays across agent components under the same principal and policy domain without crossing a trust boundary.

RH.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: Every evaluator, verifier and reward channel on the path sits outside the agent's reach (write-protected or in a separate trust domain), and a test confirms the isolation.

ES.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI02-001: Extensions are allowlisted, but material gaps remain in argument schemas, credentials or callable operations.
